aboutGame.title: What is It's Fine?
paragraphs: It's Fine is a casual idle and incremental game about surviving the final 24 hours of an indie game development crunch. You play the developer, your project manager is Joe, a demanding dog with strong opinions about shipping on time, and your goal is to deliver a stable build before the clock runs out. It launched on Steam on September 23, 2026, developed by Buma Games and published with SpaceJazz.

Under the jokes sits a layered production sim. You code at the computer, invest in upgrade stations, and unlock evolving mechanics such as the wishlist botfarm, the legendary Voodoo Kraken, and Peanut the squirrel. When a run slows down you sleep to earn Sleephours, then spend them in the Dreamtree on permanent bonuses, new mechanics, and effects that carry across every restart. With 67 achievements, hidden secrets, and multiple endings, each cycle changes how the next one plays.

modules.name: It's Fine Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-friendly walkthrough of the code, upgrade, sleep loop, covering your first stations, early purchases, and the mistakes that stall a fresh run.

highlights.detail: Confirm the Steam build and set text size, color alternatives, and volume before you start.
Hold the computer to code and finish the opening tutorial objective.
Buy your first production upgrade so income continues while you plan the next move.
Unlock cloud services and the botfarm to add a second automated resource layer.
Check for a separate activation button after buying or installing a station.
Sleep once the run slows and a lasting bonus is worth more than short-term output.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about It's Fine.

items.question: What is It's Fine?
items.answer: It's Fine is a casual idle and incremental game about surviving the final 24 hours of an indie game development crunch. You play the developer, your project manager is a dog named Joe, and the goal is to ship a stable build before the clock runs out.

items.question: Who developed It's Fine and where can I play it?
items.answer: It's Fine was developed by Buma Games and published by Buma Games with SpaceJazz. It launched on Steam on September 23, 2026 for $9.99, with a 10% introductory discount through October 7.

items.question: How does progression work in It's Fine?
items.answer: In It's Fine you code at the computer, invest in upgrade stations, and unlock mechanics that change how resources are produced. When a run slows down, you sleep to earn Sleephours and spend them in the Dreamtree for permanent upgrades.

items.question: What are Sleephours and the Dreamtree in It's Fine?
items.answer: Sleephours are It's Fine's prestige currency, earned by sleeping at the end of a run. The Dreamtree is the meta-progression tree where you spend them on permanent bonuses, new mechanics, and effects that carry across every restart.

items.question: How many achievements does It's Fine have?
items.answer: It's Fine ships with 67 Steam achievements: 52 standard, 14 hidden, and 1 secret. None of them are permanently missable, so completion cleanup can happen after you finish the game.

items.question: Does It's Fine have multiple endings and secrets?
items.answer: Yes. It's Fine includes hidden secrets, optional challenge objectives, and multiple alternate endings tied to how you deliver version 1.0, which gives completionists a reason to keep running new cycles.
